Text-to-speech with specific voice selection

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateSpeechRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = CreateSpeechRequest.from_json("{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"tts-1\",\"voice\":\"nova\"}")
    result = await client.speech(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
